headline: Chiefs face a tough third down
what_happened: P.Mahomes threw a pass to K.Walker that was incomplete, meaning the ball hit the ground before anyone caught it.
who: The play involved P.Mahomes and K.Walker.
why_it_matters: Since they failed to catch the ball, the team is now closer to having to give it up, which makes winning slightly harder. It is bad news for the Chiefs as they struggle to move closer to scoring.
